annotations.title: UK-to-Ireland car import landed cost and margin

description: Use to judge a UK import: converts the GBP price and adds shipping, customs duty, import VAT, VRT, NOx levy and a cost buffer to give the landed cost in EUR. Provide make, model, year and mileage to also get the expected margin against the Irish market median. Duty and VAT default to 0 and must be set by the caller; results are estimates. Use estimate_irish_vrt instead when you only need VRT and NOx for an already Irish-valued vehicle. Costs 0.01 USDC per call via x402; no-data results are free.

co2_g_km.description: WLTP CO2 emissions in g/km (drives the VRT band).

customs_duty_pct.description: Customs duty percent. Default 0 (GB-built cars may attract ~10%).

fuel_type.description: Fuel type, e.g. Petrol, Diesel, Electric, Petrol Hybrid, Petrol Plug-in Hybrid.

gbp_eur_rate.description: GBP to EUR rate. Defaults to the service rate.

import_vat_pct.description: Import VAT percent. Default 0; set 23 if it applies.

make.description: Optional; with model, year and mileage_km enables the margin calculation.

nox_mg_km.description: NOx mg/km for the NOx levy. Default 40.

other_costs_eur.description: Other costs in EUR. Defaults to the service cost buffer (500).

name: import_calculator
title: UK-to-Ireland car import landed cost and margin
